stratagems.name: Cult Ambush
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy models. Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot be targeted by Overwatch.

stratagems.name: Blasting Charges
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack with a grenade or blast weapon, on an unmodified Hit roll of 6, that attack scores 1 additional hit.

stratagems.name: Twisted Helix
stratagems.target: One GENESTEALER CULTS GENESTEALER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of models in your unit.
